description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'Banner' controller class within the OpenCart admin section, specifically handling operations related to banner management such as listing, editing, creating, and deleting banners. It includes methods for rendering views, processing form submissions, and fetching banner data from the model.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for managing banners within the OpenCart administration panel. Handles actions such as displaying the list of banners, editing existing banners, creating new ones, and deleting banners.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the banner management page, initializes the page with language, title, breadcrumbs, and loads the banner list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches and outputs the list of banners, typically called via AJAX or direct URL access.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the banner list, including data such as banners, pagination, and sorting.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a banner, loading existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to save or update banner details, with permission checks and validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected banners after permission verification, responds with JSON status.
